none: PAS CAM-B8F824: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Helena, AD 337-341
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ PAX PV-[BLICA] ; D/ [FL IVL HE]

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena, AD 337-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads PAX PV-[BLICA]. Reverse shows Pax standing left holding branch and transverse septre. Mint is probably Trier. Obverse legend reads [FL IVL HE] - LENAE AVG. Obverse shows a draped bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.44g, diameter is 15.0mm, thickness is 1.5mm
